reviews.text: My yorkipoo has been a client since 2022. At Mr. Paw Pet, he has always been well and carefully groomed. My dog has not shown any kind if stress before or after his grooming sessions. The staff is knowledgeable and receptive. We are looking forward to his next visit!

The best service, very kind, caring and patient. My dog had been scared to get a haircut after getting groomed somewhere else and they were able to give him a wash and cut and make him feel comfortable and he came out happy and I’m very happy with the results. He smells great and looks wonderful. Glad to have found a permanent place to get him groomed. Give them a try, definitely won’t disappoint.

The worst place. I took my Goldendoodle for a haircut and was very disappointed with the result. They cut it much shorter than I expected, practically shaved all over, and the result wasn't what I had requested. I understand that the cut can vary, but I think they should have confirmed with me before cutting it so short. I hope that on my next visit they will be more careful with the client's instructions.

⭐ 1 star

Very bad experience. I took my dog ​​for a haircut and clearly explained how I wanted it to look, but the result was completely different from what I expected. They cut his hair extremely short, practically bald, and my dog ​​was unrecognizable.

I understand that a haircut can't be perfect, but this was too much. I think that before making such a drastic change they should confirm with the owner, especially when it's a dog with a coat type like a Goldendoodle's.

I was very disappointed with the service and I wouldn't take my dog ​​to this place again. I definitely expected much more care and attention.
Provided great care for my Chapo. My dog always looked great and was happy leaving the groomers. He passed away recently. 😔 …

Mr. Paw pet grooming provided exceptional cat grooming for my baby. He did a wash, trim, blow dry and eye cleaning. He handled my baby with care and did a fantastic job in making her look fresh and clean! I would highly recommend to reach out and book your appointment!
I don’t need to describe anything,you bc an from his face 😊

My favorite family owned pet grooming, I was recommended by a friend whose dog has been going here forever. My cats always come back smelling so good & looking amazing. They pay very close attention to detail! After their appt I was told behavioral, and even heath recommendations. Very reasonable price & super local to anyone in Queens.
Staff was attentive and very helpful. Overall, the experience was fantastic. I would definitely recommend and plan on coming back in the near term.

Do not bring your dog here for nail trimming. Made my dog bleed, which is unacceptable. Never had this issue at Petco, my dog does not move around and is well behaved. Do not come here for nail trimming, your dog will suffer
Amazing job omg!!! And my dog is anxious I was worried about him sitting still and even with how he was acting he was still able to cut his hair perfectly!! You officially have a customer for life!

Love this place always taking care of my dog for the past 6 years plus Carlos is amazing highly recommend please give this man business he is awesome he takes extra care very hard to find a good groomer these days
Great service and a great price, they made my Hope look beautiful! 😍

I love Mr. Paw! Carlos always knows exactly how to leave my Dashy looking flawless. We brought him in looking very rough, with inconsistent lengths of his hair & Carlos was still able to even out his hair and make him look beautiful.
